/ /rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo dharmā ya/bha ṭā rā ka ā nan+da rat+na shra

tei:div.tei:p: // rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /na mo dharmā ya/ bha ṭā rā ka ā nan+da rat+na shrī bha dra/ zhes don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos pa rje btsun kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rtogs brjod/ tshigs bcad nyung ngur sdeb pa/ ngo mtshar rtogs brjod kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ skyob pa nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la/ rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams na// sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs rgyal po bzhugs pa de'i// thugs sras byang sems li tsa bī gzhon nu// thub dbang bstan pa gog la mgon sangs rgyas mi 'khrug des skul// rgyal sras de li tsa bī/ yis sprul pa ches mang bkyes// rgya gar grong khyer yangs pa can gang de'i// khang stong zhig tu na rdzu btab nas/ nad pa'i tshul bstan tshe// ston pas nyan thos lnga brgya nad 'drir btang*// nyan thos de rnams stong nyid chos sgras btul// de rjes ston pas bskul nas 'jam dbyangs byon// mal khrir nyal la khyod nad gang yin dris// nad 'di snying rje chen po las byung zhes// de sogs nges don chos kyi sgo mang phye// de dus shā ri'i bu ni 'di skad sems// khang stong 'di ru sdod pa'i stan med snyam// gzhon nus shes nas 'jam dpal la smras pa// khyod kyi khri stan gang bzang mthong de shod// sangs rgyas lhun sgron zhing gi khri stan nyid// khri stan gzhan las bzang zhes 'jam dpal smra// de tshe li tsa gzhon nus bsams ma thag /seng khri sum khri nyis stong khyim der byung*// 'jam dbyangs la sogs byang sems nyan thos 'khod// shā ri'i bu yang bsod snyoms gang bza' snyam// gzhon nus shes nas spos mchog brtsegs zhing gi /zhal zas blangs nas 'khor rnams tshim mdzad cing*// mngon dga'i zhing yang zhing 'dir bcug pa sogs// rdzu 'phrul chos zab bstan pas thams cad btul// gzhon nus slar yang lo grangs bzhi brgya na// bhe ta'i yul du klu sgrub zhes byar sprul// shākya'i bstan la seng sgra thengs gsum bsgrags// dang por gtam tshogs las kyi rgyu 'bras bstan// bar du rigs tshogs stong nyid seng ge'i sgra// tha mar bstod tshogs gsang sngags zab mo'i gtam// de nas lo grangs stong dang lnga brgya'i dus// gzhon nus sprul pa slar yang bod 'dir bkye// skyu ra 'jig rten gsum mgon rin chen dpal// snying rje pad dkar mdo las lung bstan bzhin// yul la khyad 'phags shing kun skye ba'i ljongs// gdung la khyad 'phags lha bab skyu ra'i gdung*// 'khor la khyad 'phags dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// chos la khyad 'phags rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig

/rten mchog khyad 'phags bkra shis sgo mang po// rten 'brel khyad 'phags zhi rgyas dbang drag can// yangs pa can du snyung rdzu btab pa sogs// rin chen dpal gyi dus rnams sngar lung bstan// lung bstan thams cad thog tu bab par mdzad// gzhon nu li tsas slar yang sprul pa bkye// 'bri gung gdung rgyud khri thog bcu gsum par// rang gi dam chos gso zhing spel byed ces// bka' chems gser khang sgo bcad ma las bsgrags// u rgyan gu ru pad+ma'i lung bstan las// zhang dbon 'khrugs pas dbus gtsang sil bur byed// snang mdzad mi g.yo rab brtan gnas pa ni// 'bri gung spyan mnga' bcu gsum pa zhes gsung*// de nyid rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can khyod// mkha' 'gros byin brlabs sgru phu zhes byar 'khrungs// snying rje mtshon phyir byis dus rmi lam du// dam can rdo rje legs pas srog snying phul// shes rab mtshon phyir 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi// yig 'bru bklags pas rang shar thugs nas thon// dad pa mtshon phyir khu bo dbang drung gi// phyag phreng sgyu ma la brten mi phyed thob// gzhan phan mtshon phyir na mnyam byis tshogs dbus// chos 'chad rdzu 'phrul rol rtsed ci yang ston// nyams myong mtshon phyir shrī dbang rat+na yis// sbyor drug phog tshe rtags bcu mngon du gyur// rtogs ldan mtshon phyir dkon mchog rat+na'i drung*// rnal 'byor bzhi rim rtogs pa shar tshul bstan// thub bstan 'dzin phyir stan gcig tshogs pa yi// gtsug rgyan mang las sdom gsum tshul bzhin nod// thabs lam mtshon phyir blo gros mtshan sogs las// bsnyen sgrub la sogs bcol po bdag pos blangs// lung bstan mtshon phyir dwags po lha rje sogs// rnal lam nang du mjal ba'i rdzu thabs gsungs// rten 'brel mtshon phyir rnag khrag zag pa dang*// mar me me 'bar ba yi rmi lam bstan// mngon shes mtshon phyir 'dan lung mtsho 'gram du// lha mos mkha' nas bskyur ba thugs dran sos// spyan lnga mtshon phyir phyag stong bcu gcig zhal// thub dbang la sogs lha mang gzig snang shar// mthu stobs mtshon phyir bya rog tu sprul pa'i// chos skyong sku las thon zhing rtag tu 'khor// gdul bya bskul phyir nyin mtshan thun 'brel bar// sgrub bzlas gtor ma brgya phyag sogs kyang mdzad// las bzhi grub mtshon gu ru pad+ma dang*// a phyi chos sgron lan mang gzigs tshul bstan// skyo ba bskyed phyir mya ngan 'da' bzhed nas// ma 'ongs lung bstan spyi dgos gsal por gsungs// rin chen dpal dang thugs rgyud gcig mtshon phyir// dbyangs su gzims pa'i ltas rnams tshul 'drar bstan// lhas mchod mtshon phyir dgun yang me tog 'bar// sngar dad med pa'i mi yang dad pa skyes// bstan rgyun mtshon phyir mgon po'i mtshan can la// bka' bsgo ji bzhin 'phrin las 'phro bsgrubs so// de ltar sngon tshe li tsa gzhon nu yis// rdzu 'phrul chos rnams ma 'ongs lung bstan tshul// klu sgrub dus dang rin chen dpal dus dang*// kun dga'i mtshan can dus rnams cha 'drar byung*// klu sgrub dus na mchod rten 'bum bzhengs pa// cha 'drar nyis stong brgyad brgya'i sgo mang bzhengs// klu sgrub nyid la'ang btsun mo'i skur pa dang*// rgyal bu'i don du dbu yang sbyin par btang*// ār+ya de bas ma he la brten nas// btsun mo'i skur 'debs 'phral du med byas shing*// rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhengs zla grags la sogs pa'i// slob ma rnams la slar yang mdo sngags gsungs// de lta'i tshul gyis kun dga'i thugs rje yang*// 'bri se byang chub gling pa dpon slob tshogs// yon gyi bdag por bcas la 'jug pa yi// bskul ma chos skyong srung mas mdzad pa'i 'os// skyob pa rin chen dpal dang kun dga'i zhabs// grub pa'i mtha' la lta ba sgom pa'i gnad// spyod pa 'bras bu'i gnad dang bzhi ru nges// lta ba dang po las 'bras bden pa dang*// bar du rang stong tha ma gzhan stong tshul// klu sgrub gtam tshogs rigs tshogs bstod tshogs ltar// stong nyid rgyu 'bras kun dga'i zhabs bzhed do// las 'bras 'chad tshe 'khor ba sdug bsngal mtsho// mtsho chen bsgral ba'i thar lam du 'jug la// byams dang snying rje'i rta 'dzegs gzhan phan gyi// bang 'gros dgos pa kun dga'i zhabs de bzhed// rang stong 'chad tshe snang grags chos 'di kun// dpyad na ma grub ri bong rwa dang 'dra// gnas lus longs spyod rmi lam ji bzhin par// ye med rtsa bral yin zhes kun dga' bzhed// gzhan stong 'chad tshe lkug pa'i rmi lam dang*// gzhon nu'i bde ltar brjod med nyams su myong*// rang sems chos sku phyag rgya chen po ni// der ngo 'phrod ces rgyal dbang kun dga' bzhed// de lta'i lta ba rim pa gsum byung ba// snang ba sems su go na gsum kha bde// yod nas snang dang med nas snang ba dang*// yod med brjod bral snang gsum kun dga' bzhed// sdig spong dge ba sgrub tshe yod nas snang*// 'di ni chos 'khor dang po'i lta ba yin// lta bas phu thag gcod tshe med nas snang*// 'di ni bar pa rang stong lta bar bzhed// nyams myong 'chad tshe yod med brjod bral snang*// gsum pa gzhan stong lta bar skyob pa bzhed// stong nyid rtogs na stong nyid rgyu 'bras su// 'char ba'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang de byon to// de yang dang por las 'bras blang dor tshe// 'dun gyi mchod rten 'di ni yod nas snang*// de la bskor bas bsod nams bgoms pas sdig

/'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan skyob pa yab sras bzhed// bar du lta bas sems thag gcod pa'i tshe// mdun gyi mchod rten ye nas med bzhin du// snang ba 'di la ma brtags nyams dga' zer// kun rdzob gtan med tshul 'di kun dga' bzhed// phyi rabs pa rnams kun rdzob chu yod lo// chus ma bkrus na sdig pa mi 'dag lo// stong skad smra la stong nyid ma go ba// 'di kun snying rje'i gnas su rgyal dbang bzhed// de ltar rang stong 'chad pa'i gsung rab ni// 'bum la sogs pa'i sher phyin mdo rnams dang*// klu sgrub dbu ma rigs tshogs 'khor bcas dang*// do ha'i glu sogs yin zhes skyob pa bzhed// phyi rabs pa rnams bdag yod gzhan yod lo// med ces smra ba hwa shang lta ba zer// lta ba'i snyigs ma mtshan 'dzin khong skran can// khyod rnams snying rje'i gnas su kun dga' bzhed// tha mar chos kyi gnas lugs bstan chog tshe// snang ba sems yin sems ni sgyu ma 'dra// bde nyams 'char yang 'dzin rgyu med pa la// gzhan stong bde stong ming 'dogs skyob pa bzhed// 'bras bu'i stong nyid bya ba 'di la zer// bral 'bras chos sku phyag rgya chen po 'di// phag mo gru ru chos khri shar nub kyi// grub mtha'i dbye ba phye dus skyob pas dgongs// de la grub chen rdor rgyal bka' bstsal pa// grub mtha' dge bsnyen sa bcu pa yis 'dzin// 'gyur ro 'gyur ro a khu khams pa 'gyur// 'khor gyis glengs pas don 'di grub par bzhed// rgyal bas lung bstan kun mkhyen dol bu ba// gang de'i grub mtha' 'di dang gnad gcig la// shākya mchog ldan zhabs kyis deng sang dus// skyob pa'i bzhed 'di lung rigs mang pos bsgrubs// sems 'grel skor gsum sogs na ches gsal zhing*// rje btsun phya pa sogs kyang 'di bzhed pas// phyi rabs grags pa can gyis 'di 'gog kyang*// dgag mi nus pa'i mchog 'di skyob pa bzhed// sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'di'i steng gcig

/mkhas grub tshad ldan kun kyang bzhed pa yi// kun rdzob ye med don dam myong grub 'di// 'jig rten gsum mgon grub mthar kun dga' bzhed// sgom pa'i gnad la sems 'dzin mang mod kyang*// rang lus lha skur sgom pa'i bsgrub gzhi ni// don dam rang sems chos sku phyag chen yin// ngo bo chos sku rnam pa gzugs skur bzhed// rang sems sangs rgyas yin nas bsgom pa'i lung*// gshis la mi gnas bltas pas mi 'gyur gsungs// rang lus lha sku 'gyur med btsan sa zin// mkha' 'gro'i 'khor mang 'du ba skyob pa bzhed// phyi rabs pa rnams tha mal phung po 'di// yi dam lha ru sgom zhes blun sgom byed// sol ba bdar bas dung du mi 'gyur ba// 'di yang snying rje'i gnas su skyob pa bzhed// kha cig bskyed rim rtog sgom yin no lo// rtog pa gsal thebs pa la ngo blta rgyab// rtog med 'dzin med ngang la 'ja' ltar myong*// bskyed rim phyag rgya chen por kun dga' bzhed// kha cig mtsho la nya chung 'phar ba ltar// bden med dran 'dzin tu re rgyun du dgos// yid la mi byed hwa shang sgom yin lo// 'di 'dra sgom gyi gol sar skyob pa bzhed// kha cig bskyed rim bor nas lta rkyang sgom// 'bras bu sangs rgyas sku gnyis 'grub pa la// de lta bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bsgom dgos par// rdo rje 'chang gi gsungs ltar skyob pa bzhed// kha cig gzhan la gnod phyir lha khro bo// bzlas tshogs dang bcas bsgoms zhing hūm̐ phaṭ bzlo// phyi ma dmyal bar 'gro la tshegs med pa// 'di 'dra 'ang snying rje'i yul du rgyal dbang bzhed// sa bka' rnying gsum sgom gyi snying po ni// ci yang yid la mi byed mnyam bzhag pas// nam mkha' lta bu'i rang sems gnyug ma mthong*// gnas lugs phyag rgya chen por kun dga' bzhed// kha cig dbang bskur med ces bka' brgyud smod// mos gus srog gi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor gyi// bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs las nyi shar bas// dbang gi chu bo mi nub skyob pa bzhed// spyod pa phyi nang gsang ba de kho na// so thar byang sems gsang sngags bhu su ku'i// bdag rkyen tha dad sdom pa gsum 'ong zhes// gzhan gyis ma go'i khyad chos kun dga' bzhed// phyi ru dge slong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i khrims// nang nas bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems// gsang bar kud+na 'pho med bde la rol// blang dor bral ba'i de nyid skyob pa bzhed// byin len gung tshigs chab sogs la 'bad kyang*// gsog 'jog rem zhing kun+da rtag tu 'dzag

/dge sbyong rul ba nyid du dus 'khor las// gsungs ltar 'dzag med bde skyong kun dga' bzhed// mi 'gyur bde rten kun+da 'pho med pa'i// thabs lam dang ldan skyes bu dge slong mchog /yin zhes dus 'khor las gsungs bhu su ku// chos gsum ldan nyid dgos par skyob pa bzhed// 'bras bu'i gnad la rang gi sems kyi gshis// chos skur bzhed pa dwags po bka' brgyud lugs// sangs rgyas thams cad chos sku gcig yin par// mdo rgyud kun las gsungs ltar kun dga' bzhed// phyi rabs pa rnams gzugs sku sangs rgyas lo// sangs rgyas skye 'chi yod pa de ngo tsha// gzugs sku gdul bya rang sems kyis bsdus par/ /sa bkar rnying gsum grub mthar skyob pa bzhed// de ltar mngon dga'i zhing nas li tsa bīs// klu sgrub rin chen dpal dang kun dgar sprul// phrin las mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa 'di bzung ngo*// gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bstan pa skyon med pa// rang sems chos sku'i rang zhal ltad mo yis// skal ldan rtag tu skyid pa 'bri gung chos// sa bkar rnying gsum gcig pa kun dga' bzhed/ ces bya ba ni/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ ngo mtshar rtogs brjod rgya mtsho zhes mtshan du gsol ba 'di/ 'bri gung paṇ+ṭi tas chos skyong gi sprul pa mgon po'i mtshan can gyi dgongs pa blangs nas bris pa'i dge bas/ 'khor ba ma stongs bar du sems can gyi don byed nus par gyur cig
bdag dang 'khor 'das dus gsum dang*/ yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa myur du thob par gyur cig// /maṅgalaṃ//
